reviews.comment: MKTG 425 - Semester long project with a lot of creative freedom. Great lectures. Tests are difficult but he gives a good study guide and lots of great feedback on every assignment. He does grade late so it can be difficult to gauge your grade.

The best and most thoughtful professor I have ever had. His tests are straightforward with a review and he's always willing to help you out on any assignment. Every assignment was clear on how to perform and either a completion grade or graded highly. Get things done and you're guaranteed an A!!
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I loved McMillan he was super sweet and always trying to relate things to the students. There were about 2 assingments each weak that was a page long each so that could be tedious and the exams were kind of hard to study for because he didn't give a review and also he does take attendance so go to class!!
